description: This file defines the MigrationHelper class, responsible for managing database migration logs in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to log the start and end of migrations, create the migration log table if needed, and fetch connection and schema helper instances.

classes.name: MigrationHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing database migration logs, including starting and finishing migration entries, and creating the migration log table if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts an optional database connection object.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the database connection, either the provided one or a default singleton.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Returns the schema helper instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: logMigrationStarted
methods.description: Logs the start of a migration, creating the migration log table if it does not exist.

methods.name: logMigrationFinished
methods.description: Logs the completion of a migration by updating the corresponding log entry with the finish timestamp.
